detail.longDescription: Agentic AI is moving fast. But is speed coming at the expense of quality? In her latest Opinion, Katie Swannell-Gibbs explores the hidden costs of AI slop in business operations, and why agents built without the right data, systems or human oversight can create more problems than they solve. Read the full piece: https://www. techfinitive.com/opinions/the- hidden-cost-of-ai-slop-inside-your-business-operations/ # AgenticAI # EnterpriseAI
